Heard learned counsel, Mr S Borthakur, for the petitioner, Bibhash Das, who has fled this application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023, with prayer for pre-arrest bail, as he is apprehending arrest in connection with PRC Case No. 130/2023, arising out of Tinsukia PS Case No. 1447/2017, under Sections 420/408 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Heard Ms S Jahan, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.

3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that charge sheet has been laid against the petitioner,
with allegation that he has sold the spare parts and accessories from the workshop of Far East Nissan Company, Tinsukia while he was serving as an employee.
Valuation of the articles is around Rs 4,63,000/-.

The petitioner is apprehending that as soon as he will appear before the trial Court Bibhash Das vs The State Of Assam on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176145782/
1 he will be forwarded to custody, as he has been shown as absconder in the charge sheet.
4. It is submitted that cognizance has already been taken and summons have been issued against the petitioner.
5. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
6. Petitioner is willing to cooperate with the trial.
7.
